WITH agg AS (
 SELECT period, SUM(qty) AS total_qty, SUM(amount_cad) AS total_cost
 FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
 WHERE period IN ('2026-08','2026-09')
 GROUP BY period
)
SELECT
 a1.period AS aug_period, a1.total_qty AS aug_qty, a1.total_cost AS aug_cost,
 a2.period AS sep_period, a2.total_qty AS sep_qty, a2.total_cost AS sep_cost,
 (a2.total_qty - a1.total_qty) AS qty_change,
 (a2.total_qty - a1.total_qty) * (a1.total_cost / a1.total_qty) AS volume_effect,
 a2.total_qty * ((a2.total_cost / a2.total_qty) - (a1.total_cost / a1.total_qty)) AS price_effect
FROM agg a1, agg a2
WHERE a1.period = '2026-08' AND a2.period = '2026-09'
